steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Shh, stay in the grass and don't come out. I had to be real careful to get you out during the day.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: The grass is too short. It can't hide my ears.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Then get lower!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: Father, that girl is rummaging in the grass.

steps.name: Elegant Man
steps.text: Shh, it's not polite to point. She must be drunk.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No! I can still see them!

steps.name: Curious Girl
steps.text: She's about to fall into the grass. Should we help?

steps.name: Elegant Man
steps.text: Shh, pretend not to see her. A little fall never hurt anyone. It's being seen falling that's really embarrassing.

steps.name: Elegant Man
steps.text: This is where the events leading up to the Flood Festival are held, and all the competitors are here today to sign up. It would be very awkward to run into her during the competition.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: It's a Menat-Ha'mait tradition to sink various items into the river as a sacrifice to the river god ahead of the Flood Festival, praying for good luck.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Guess where we can find the rarest gems in the city.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: In the river.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Wait here while I go get one of the bush trimming carts. You can sit in the bin for collecting fallen leaves.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That way, we can get you to the river without anyone finding out!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Are you sure this is a good idea?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Come on, stop tugging at my shirt and act your age!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Stay hidden and stay put! I'll be back soon!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Meow... meooow...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: A... creature?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Lifts tail elegantly)

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Ah, many statues here were carved in your likeness.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Wags tail proudly)

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Beautiful. No wonder the people here love you so much.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Holds up backside with dignity)

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Do you want me to pet you? But you're too far, and Pepe told me not to move from here.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Makes a deliberate display)

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Can you come closer?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Shakes tail irritably)

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Please don't be angry. Perhaps I can move forward a little.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Meow...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hey, Zubayr, stop gawking at cloudbeasts. Look what I've found!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...Why do you look so dour?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I am not dour.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Then get in here. I've measured it, it should fit you with room to spare.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: It's a little dirty...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Dirty? Just some fallen leaves and a piece of scrap paper. You were dug out of a hole filled with sand and dirt!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: ...I respectfully decline.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'll clean it. Fallen leaves... scrap paper... it's a leaflet. It's not even that dirty.
Pepe spreads open the rolled-up ball of paper.
She freezes on the spot.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Harvest Gathering? What is that?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Part of the local festivities... competitors display their most valued possessions, and the winners get prizes from the sponsors.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Many of the prizes are familiar. The second-place prize, in particular, brings back memories.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Of course it does, Zubayr.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Do I still have to go into the bin?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Of course. I cleaned it for you.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Mmh...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Mumbles in sleep)

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: This way... the mummy won't...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...Whoa!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Is she finally awake?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: —Damn. I'm glad that was just a dream.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I don't want to be haunted by the dead this young.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Please don't throw the vessel. Even if it is your own, you may not harm others while using it.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Sorry. I thought it was my knife I was throwing.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Apology accepted. Good morning.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Wait, morning?
In the silence, Narantuya sizes up the stranger before her, who gives off the aura of a seasoned warrior.
She slowly moves her hand to her belt, while carefully taking in her surroundings.
Her coin purse is still tied to her belt, but her weapons are gone.
Her knives are lying on the tea table, on the other side of this unfamiliar room.
The room itself seems unremarkable, but this is a city where even the manhole covers are laid with gems.
Narantuya knows that even the most unremarkable thing here can command a remarkable price.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh... it was you who saved my life?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Thank you so much, kind soul! Once I get out of here, I'll have all my subordinates remember your name!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: How much do you want?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I'm sorry?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: If you mean the bread and fruit that I brought back from my morning jog, these were gift from others that should not be valued in terms of money.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I wasn't asking about that, or why I don't get good stuff like that when I walk the streets.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: —Wait, you mean it's free?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Good. The sun is my witness, no taking back your word.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I appreciate the kindness.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: How are you feeling?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Based on my medical knowledge, I do not believe you're injured, but you had been unconscious for a long time...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh, I'd forgotten to sleep for a while. Guess I was making up for it.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: No worries. Consider it a... bad hereditary habit.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Hereditary?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: As long as it's nothing serious. Feeling unwell anywhere?
She reaches for her neck instinctively.
The needle wound has healed, but the memories from before the long nightmare begin to float to the surface.
The pass that never arrived, the failed kidnapping, the terrifying mummy, the feeling of freefall, the faint sound of wind.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: That was the tenth floor... I didn't think I would ever wake up from that.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Wow, is that what dying feels like? It's terrible! Thank you for saving my life.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: They say that one can never truly die, if her name continues to be spoken after her death.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: But if eternal life means an eternal nightmare of being chased by mummies to the ends of the sands... then I must reconsider whether it's worth it to have my name known all across Sargon.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: You jumped from the window because you wanted to have your name known all across Sargon?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hm? I suppose.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I fail to understand the Sargonian obsession with such tradition... I sympathize. Had things not been going well for you in life?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Racked up a debt. It's been a pretty big headache.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Say, I want to ask you...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: You saved my life, and I ought to repay you.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Do you want to work for me? I'm planning something of a great endeavor.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I remember now. I made a wish when I fell from the building.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I guess you're that 'competent subordinate' granted by fate.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Very well. I'm happy to be of help, if it alleviates your stress and gives you the will to live.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Anat! Anat! Look what I found!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I don't know what you found, but I found that you've been sneaking away with the museum's collection again.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: And putting him in a dirty... leaf bin.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Sorry, I just couldn't bear to watch him waste away in the museum, so I took him out to get some fresh air.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Er... yes, Anat Hanim, I was interested in seeing the outside.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: See? Let's drop this and talk about the good stuff I found.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Hm... a creased leaflet?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Look what it says!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: The typical pre-festival events.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Wait, is that...?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The third gem that Zubayr and I have been looking for!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Didn't you say you took Zubayr out because he was wasting away in the museum?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Kill two fowlbeasts with one stone, as they say.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Did you think about how to get the gem? Second-place is not exactly easy to get.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: The Harvest Gathering attracts the rich and noble, eager to show off their treasures. I know of at least two padishahs who are visiting anonymously.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I can help you appraise ancient artifacts, or volunteer myself as the entry...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No worries, that's the easy part.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The hard part is finishing second.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The entry has to be extraordinary, but not unique. It must represent an era, but not symbolize it.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You need finish exactly second to get the 'large gem with unique characteristics and Shah-era markings'.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: How to finish second...? That is the question.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Heheh.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Do you have an idea?
Pepe does not answer. She looks up at the skylight, squinting.
It is past noon, and sunlight spills through the round skylight, casting an oval of light on the ground.
Standing in the middle of the oval, Pepe grins from ear to ear, pointing at the sun outside.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Heknu, Horakhet.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Entering with a Horakhet statue? Not a bad choice.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No, I'm just expressing my gratitude for His inspiration. I'm not entering an item associated with Him.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Look at the circle He's casting on the ground. Doesn't it look like...?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I see. You plan to enter with a talisman engraved with a royal name. The cartouche is the symbol of good fortune and warding against evil. Perhaps that will catch the attention of the judges...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What are you people talking about?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Isn't this oval of light just like a golden slipper?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Slipper?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Yes. I'm winning that gem with a golden slipper that's been passed down through my family for generations!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I don't want to keep crouching behind this wall. Can I go in with you?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Stop complaining. I got you your ice cream. Can you actually taste it though?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: No... I'm just curious what all those people were queuing for.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Is your curiosity satisfied? Eat up, or your head is going to melt in the sun.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Ice treat created in my image... I'm surprised how popular I am here.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: You may not be able to taste it, but you can feel the coolness, right?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Not so much a sensation as an impulse...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: An impulse to jump into the river, allow the water to flow over me, and have a good swim.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That's just how we normally spend the summer, isn't it? Oh right... gold sinks in water.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: That's why I described it as an impulse.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Alright, alright, be patient, and I'll take you to the largest artificial lake in town once the sun goes down and the competition has ended.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'll be going. See you later.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: (Pulls up cape)

steps.name: Choir
steps.text: ♪The papyrus reeds sway by the river, its waters of purest lazurite♪

steps.name: Choir
steps.text: ♪It wends its way by the golden dunes, fed by our gifts of gems♪

steps.name: Plainly-Dressed Woman
steps.text: I knew you were here when I smelled synthesized courmarin.

steps.name: Plainly-Dressed Woman
steps.text: My watch tells me the competition doesn't start for another thirty minutes. I thought it was unfashionable in the new city to arrive on time.

steps.name: Bejeweled Man
steps.text: Twenty-seven minutes and fifty seconds, to be precise. My watch is more accurate.

steps.name: Bejeweled Man
steps.text: After all, its mechanism is based on the machine that the Shah of Past and Future invented after he discovered the artifact that gave mastery over time.

steps.name: Bejeweled Man
steps.text: Your idea of time is as vague as that sundial in the museum. You do not understand that the every grain of sand passing through the hourglass is a gold coin, when one arrives too early and has to wait.

steps.name: Plainly-Dressed Woman
steps.text: True, I believe this antique was last calibrated when the sundial was dug up. I wonder where your ancestors were, at the time.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Perhaps I should inform them that it's actually 11:25, and both of them should adjust their watches.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: This sports watch is waterproof and dustproof, and has a compass on it. I wear it on my monthly climb of the Heria Mountains, and I can recommend it to them based on firsthand experience.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Don't bother them. You got some free time, go try some other drinks.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I like this iced guava juice more than the herbal tea.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I'll get a few more cups if you want.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'm fine, I'm no padishah, I know how to use my hands.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: So... you're not contemplating suicide?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Why would I, when you can get all sorts of free drinks just walking through a city garden like this—

steps.name: Proud Woman
steps.text: If I may say so, my hundred-thousand dinar burdenbeast pulls the carriage faster. It could knock a grown man down with its wake.

steps.name: Composed Man
steps.text: If I may say so, stability is the most important thing, and that's what the burdenbeasts of my ranch offer.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh!—Novsh! My cup!

steps.name: Composed Man
steps.text: Unlike you, I don't have to pull down the curtains to stop sand sent flying by a carriage, or juice spilled by passersby.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: What are these people doing here? This place is for drinks!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Don't worry, I caught it. Not a single drop of guava juice was spilled.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Let's find a place to sit by the roadside.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Mutters) She's the competent subordinate I've been wishing for alright... but am I even the boss, at this rate?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Mutters) I should introduce her to Ajazi and Ajani.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Did you say something?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: No, I was just thinking I would take a trip to the museum after I've tried all the drinks here.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: You're going there too?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Yeah, but I'm not as interested as you in the artifacts. I just lost something and I need to start searching from the last place I saw it.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Not a single beep from my communicator after all this time? Not one call?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Unfortunately, the museum has remained closed ever since the incident, and I doubt the management would promptly contact the owners of lost items as promised.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Whenever I close my eyes, I think back to the day when I glimpsed a fragment of the lost glory of ancient Minos, and the disarray within that grand museum.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Setting everything aside, it is unbelievable that the staff could not recall the locations of the exhibit halls and the routes to them.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Leading dozens of panicking tourists to the Northeast... to the Minoan exhibit, where there were no exits.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I must strongly express my dissatisfaction when I have a chance to meet with museum management.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Ha... I changed my mind. Let's not go to the museum today.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: Excuse me. I see you're enjoying the drinks we have on offer today.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: The two of you have lingered here for a while. Perhaps you are interested in participating in the Harvest Gathering?

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: You appear to be tourists. This pamphlet will give you details about this key event leading up to the Flood Festival.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Not interested.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Let's go, Aspasia... Aspasia?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Fate has smiled on me at last.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Narantuya, you say you have visited the museum. Perhaps you know what this is.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: No idea... isn't it just a simple old cup?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: This is my family goblet!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: The other goblet, to be precise.
